answer: The sparrow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The vine holds work receipts rather than names, so the terrace of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
